simple.meaning: דָּהַר (dâhar) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to curvet or move irregularly.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Nahum, beginning at Nahum 3:2. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דָּהַר (H1725) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: דָּהַר (dâhar) / H1725 is traced through Nahum 3:2 with source-language evidence and verse context.
